The issuer shows very strong financial performance with significant scale (LTM revenue run-rate exceeding $48B, high gross margins of 72%, and an operating margin of 30%). Although its balance sheet is highly leveraged with total liabilities of $78.3B relative to equity of $18.6B, it maintains adequate short-term liquidity with a current ratio of 1.27 and substantial absolute profitability. These strong operating dynamics and substantial market scale support an investment-grade rating in the A-category.

DECISION: A-
